title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0699, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.0699, 0.0) and ends at (0.0699, 0.75); the third line starts at (0.0699, 0.75) and ends at (0.0, 0.75); and the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.75) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.015 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting dimensions of the rectangular base with rounded edges are a length of 0.06988352745424307 units, a width of 0.7499999999999998 units, and a height of 0.01497504159733777 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.box(0.0699, 0.75, 0.015, centered=(False, False, False))

# The box command creates a box with the specified dimensions
# The dimensions provided are length, width, and height
# The centered parameter is set to False to ensure the box starts from the origin (0, 0, 0)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0699, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0699, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.015)
